import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689779/attempts/75b9ca6211d4403aafd75899a9af5d34/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Find the separator rows and columns (uniform lines of color 4).
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 4 for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_bounds[i]+1, row_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1)]
    col_spans = [(col_bounds[i]+1, col_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1)]
    # Select the panel containing non-background marks; copy it into every panel.
    panels = [(rs, cs) for rs in row_spans for cs in col_spans]
    source = None
    for rs, cs in panels:
        if any(grid[r][c] not in (1,4) for r in range(*rs) for c in range(*cs)):
            source = [row[cs[0]:cs[1]] for row in grid[rs[0]:rs[1]]]
            break
    if source is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for rs, cs in panels:
        for i,r in enumerate(range(*rs)):
            for j,c in enumerate(range(*cs)):
                out[r][c] = source[i % len(source)][j % len(source[0])]
    return out
'''
(base/'task-26de1145.py').write_text(code)
